non_blocking_notes: The collapse of FW-ASOC-01/02 into FW-ASOC maintains bounded scope by explicitly listing no full external orchestration or Z3 solver in limitations, preventing over-claiming.
The validation function enforces that Proven requires IMPLEMENTED, INTEGRATED, and ACCEPTED_BOUNDED states.
Every entry fixes operating_mode to DRY_RUN and live_enabled and production_ready to false.
proposed_rules: Require every Proven functionality-map entry to carry IMPLEMENTED, INTEGRATED, and ACCEPTED_BOUNDED evidence states.
result.reasoning_summary: FW-INTEGRITY-004 introduces a structured canonical capability map and fail-closed validator. All 22 accepted families appear exactly once, with FW-ASOC and FW-CORE retained as explicit foundational records. Each record exposes implementation, integration, bounded proof, demo, operating, live, production, and limitation state. Validation rejects duplicate, missing, malformed, stronger-than-evidence, live-enabled, and production-ready claims. The change is metadata and validation only and adds no execution or authority.
